description: This file contains a JUnit test class 'CredentialsTest' for testing the 'Credentials' class within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.connectivity package. It specifically tests the deserialization of X509 credentials from a JSON object.

classes.name: CredentialsTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the Credentials deserialization logic.
